title: On Reducing the cost by a third
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：reduce　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 reduce 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the driver ① reduced the cost by a third before dawn, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② reduces the cost by a third in public without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ reduce the cost by a third at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reduced the cost by a third before — a line in the timetable for February 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reducing the cost by a third before dawn, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ reduce him to half his old wages in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Reduce him to half his old wages at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ reduces him to half his old wages before dawn every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reduced the cost by a third again when nobody else would.

⑩ To reduce the cost by a third, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody reduces the cost by a third in public again and somebody must reduce the cost by a third before dawn all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 削减（一般过去式 reduced the cost by a third：1984 年司机头一回这样做，天没亮就）
B. v. 削减（一般现在 reduces the cost by a third：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 削减（不定式 to reduce the cost by a third：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 削减（过去完成时 had reduced the cost by a third：1978 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 削减（动名词 reducing the cost by a third 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 降为（reduce him to half his old wages：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去降为把他的工钱减到从前的一半）
G. v. 降为（reduce him to half his old wages：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 削减（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 reduces him to half his old wages，而母亲又一次 reduced the cost by a third）

answers.why: reduce 意为“削减”，1984 年司机天没亮就削减把花销减掉三分之一，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reduced。
reduce 意为“削减”，自那以后司机当着众人面把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reduces。
reduce 意为“削减”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯削减把花销减掉三分之一”，此处为不定式 to reduce the cost by a third。
reduce 意为“削减”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人削减过，故用过去完成时 had reduced。
reduce 意为“削减”，司机说“削减把花销减掉三分之一这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reducing the cost by a third 作主语。
reduce 意为“降为”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去降为把他的工钱减到从前的一半”，should ever 之后用原形 reduce him to half his old wages。
reduce 意为“降为”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻降为把他的工钱减到从前的一半（reduce him to half his old wages at once），以后再也不要提起。
reduce 意为“削减”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例降为把他的工钱减到从前的一半，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reduces。
reduce 意为“削减”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次天没亮就削减把花销减掉三分之一，用一般过去式 reduced 叙述。
reduce 意为“削减”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要削减把花销减掉三分之一，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 reduce 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the driver reduced the cost by a third before dawn, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver reduces the cost by a third in public whenever the station asks.
Reducing the cost by a third before dawn, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever reduce him to half his old wages in public, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station reduces him to half his old wages before dawn every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reduced the cost by a third again, and the station remembered that half.
